## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Treviso, Italy. It starts at Via Antonio Canova, 74.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Visit the Gypsotheca Antonio Canova Museum in Possagno to see the legacy of Antonio Canova, the famous neoclassical sculptor.
>
> The museum includes the Birth House and the Gypsotheca, housed in the original 1836 basilica and expanded by Carlo Scarpa in 1957. The Gypsotheca displays original plaster models used to create marble sculptures now in major museums worldwide.
>
> The Birth House contains Canova's paintings, drawings, prints, and personal items. The museum offers guided tours, educational workshops, and candlelit evening visits.
